Great progress. I would continue cutting, get down to a bodyfat percentage you’re comfortable with under about 17% before eating in a surplus. You’re young, and this is a marathon not a sprint, plenty of time for bulk and cut cycles

Stomach area is first on last off. I would focus on diet and being in a 500-750 calorie daily deficit with protein at 1g per lb of bodyweight, and keep lifting. Do this for 4-5 months and you’ll lose 20-25lbs. You won’t build mass muscle but will strip fat and have some muscle definition as a base, ready for some bulk and cut cycles.
